definitions.explanation: To produce the sounds of speech. Used when discussing how words or sounds are spoken, especially in language learning and linguistics contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{単語|たんご}→単語：03413_tango⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦どう→どう：00543_dou⟧⟦{発音|はつおん}→発音：01698_hatsuon⟧します⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: How do you pronounce this word?

examples.japanese: 「つ」⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{正|ただ}しく→正しい：00893_tadashii⟧{発音|はつおん}する⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧。
examples.english: It is difficult to pronounce 'tsu' correctly.

examples.japanese: ⟦{英語|えいご}→英語：02274_eigo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧「r」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧「l」⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{区別|くべつ}して→区別する：26970_kubetsusuru⟧⟦{発音|はつおん}→発音：01698_hatsuon⟧できない。
examples.english: I can't distinguish and pronounce the English 'r' and 'l' separately.

examples.japanese: ⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧あと⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{続|つづ}いて→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧⟦{発音|はつおん}→発音：01698_hatsuon⟧してみて⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please try pronouncing it after the teacher.

notes:
Essential vocabulary for language learners. The noun ⟦{発音|はつおん}→発音：01698_hatsuon⟧ is used frequently on its own to mean "pronunciation" and appears in many educational contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{発音|はつおん}→発音：01698_hatsuon⟧⟦{練習|れんしゅう}→練習：05323_renshuu⟧: pronunciation practice
- ⟦{発音|はつおん}→発音：01698_hatsuon⟧⟦{記号|きごう}→記号：00224_kigou⟧: phonetic symbols
- ⟦{正|ただ}しい→正しい：00893_tadashii⟧⟦{発音|はつおん}→発音：01698_hatsuon⟧: correct pronunciation
- ⟦{発音|はつおん}→発音：01698_hatsuon⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧: to have good pronunciation
- ⟦{発音|はつおん}→発音：01698_hatsuon⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧: to have poor pronunciation

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧: to read — may include reading aloud but not focused on sound production
- ⟦{話|はな}す→話す：00467_hanasu⟧: to speak — broader act of communication
- ⟦{唱|とな}える→唱える：10467_tonaeru⟧: to chant — reciting formulaic phrases or prayers
